Internal helper: the font family R draws a style's font with

Source: R/plot.R
dot-jst_plot_family.Rd

Arial and its kin draw as R's "sans" family, which is Arial on Windows and Helvetica, of the same widths, on a Mac; Times New Roman and its kin as "serif"; Courier New as "mono". So the built-ins draw on every device, the PDF device R CMD check and a script use among them. Any other face is passed by name, where a device can find it: the PDF and PostScript devices know only their own fonts, so there it is drawn as "sans"; Windows' devices need the face named in R's font table, which is done here once for the session.

Usage

.jst_plot_family(font, device = NULL)

Arguments

font

Character(1), the style's font.

device

NULL for the device a plot will be drawn on now, or the name of the device it will be drawn on ("png", "pdf", "postscript").

Value

Character(1), a font family.
